def detect_language(text):
    t = text.lower()
    words = set(t.split())
    if words & {"hello", "the", "is", "and", "you"}:
        return "english"
    if words & {"hola", "el", "es", "y", "gracias"}:
        return "spanish"
    if words & {"bonjour", "le", "est", "et", "merci"}:
        return "french"
    if words & {"hallo", "der", "ist", "und", "danke"}:
        return "german"
    return "unknown"


test_suite = [
    ("Hello how are you", "english"),
    ("Hola gracias amigo", "spanish"),
    ("Bonjour et merci", "french"),
    ("Hallo und danke", "german"),
    ("The sky is blue", "english"),
    ("El perro es grande", "spanish"),
    ("xyzzy plugh", "unknown"),
]

correct = 0
for prompt_input, expected_output in test_suite:
    if detect_language(prompt_input) == expected_output:
        correct += 1

suite_accuracy = correct / len(test_suite)
print(f"Accuracy: {suite_accuracy:.2f}")
